4279-6026-7452--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6026-7452--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence, Field of Souls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Field of Souls ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

549-5330-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
549-5330-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.
549-5330-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

1563-2457-4321-8201.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

5078-6650-8176.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
5078-6650-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-8174.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Mabel.
When Mabel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Mabel enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

558-6034-8089.easyPrerequisites: Pact Weapon attached to a creature you control.
558-6034-8089.description:
Activate Carrion Howler by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1818-4399-4518-6626.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Healer of the Pride trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1818-4399-4518-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

2685-2919-3263-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-2919-3263-5641.description:
Gain life in any way.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

864-5195-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying {W}, targeting Eternal Witness
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Eternal Witness
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1308-1558-3756-3875-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1308-1558-3756-3875-4231.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Anointed Procession.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4050-6255-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
4050-6255-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Zahur and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Zahur trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1778-2099-4053-6989.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Memnite.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

2981-4375-5361.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Megatog by sacrificing Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

3609-6188-6750.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Inspirit has one or more charge counters on it.
3609-6188-6750.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Inspirit triggers, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Declare Fear of Missing Out as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to untap a creature you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your second combat phase. At the beginning of the combat phase, Inspirit triggers, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1365-2292-2608-6582.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Derevi and Aerith persist until end of turn.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Derevi.
When Derevi dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Aerith.
When Aerith dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve Aerith's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Aerith trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each legendary creature you control, thus removing the -1/-1 counters from Aerith and Derevi.
Resolve the Viscera Seer abilities from steps 2 and 5.
Repeat.
1365-2292-2608-6582.notes: The combo does not put +1/+1 counters on Derevi or Aerith, but does on any other legendary creature(s) you control.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

1810-2743-6669.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Cackling Counterpart
1810-2743-6669.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase. Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast twice.
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Summon: G.F. Cerberus triggers, copying Cackling Counterpart twice, with the copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Cackling Counterparts, copying Biovisionary three times.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

3490-4659-6600.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-4659-6600.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Shelinda triggers, either putting a +1/+1 counter on it or the creature that entered the battlefield.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

2131-5636-5660.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature or artifact card in your graveyard.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
2131-5636-5660.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning an artifact or creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Thran Vigil triggers. Holding priority, activate Psychic Frog by discarding an artifact or creature card.
Resolve the Thran Vigil ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Repeat from step 2.

710-2961-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, False Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

880-1659-5478.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-1659-5478.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the land enters the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

372-4598-5913.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Essence Flux exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Pinnacle Monk exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Essence Flux.
372-4598-5913.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Pinnacle Monk and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Pinnacle Monk trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Essence Flux.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Pinnacle Monk and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1354-1835-4275-4365.notablePrerequisites: Zaxara does not have summoning sickness.
1354-1835-4275-4365.description:
Activate Zaxara by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying {2}{G}{G}.
Zaxara triggers, creating two 0/0 Hydra creature tokens.
The Hydras enter the battlefield and die as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Faces of the Past trigger twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all Hydras.
Activate Zaxara by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the second Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Hydras.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a 0/0 Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
The Wurm enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
When the Wurm dies, Faces of the Past triggers, either tapping or untapping all Wurms.
Repeat.

413-3621-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard tokens.

1429-2127-5256.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-2127-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Tribute to the World Tree triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Lesser Masticore .
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Lesser Masticore's power.
Repeat.

253-739-2798-4827.notablePrerequisites: You have Gideon of the Trials' emblem.
253-739-2798-4827.description:
Activate Evra by paying {4}.
Holding priority, cast Humble by paying {1}{W}, causing Evra to have base power and toughness 0/1 until end of turn.
Resolve Evra's ability, swapping your life total with Evra's power.
Activate Soul of Conduit by paying {6} and tapping it, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.

427-1689-3148-4067.notablePrerequisites:
You have drawn at least four cards this turn.
Kydele does not have summoning sickness.
427-1689-3148-4067.description:
Activate Kydele by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Thrasios by paying {4}, causing you to draw a card, then reveal the top card of your library and put it onto the battlefield tapped if it's a land, or draw a card otherwise.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Kydele.
Repeat.

1365-4404-4751-5256.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Verdurous Gearhulk and Corridor Monitor persist until end of turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Corridor Monitor.
Corridor Monitor dies, triggering its persist ability, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Verdurous Gearhulk.
Verdurous Gearhulk dies, triggering its persist ability, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Verdurous Gearhulk enters the battlefield, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and Corridor Monitor, and two +1/+1 counters on any other creature(s) you control.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities, causing target player to mill cards equal to Corridor Monitor and Verdurous Gearhulk's power.
Repeat.

262-1228-2959.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Goblin Sharpshooter.
Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.
262-1228-2959.description:
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying {2}{R}, creating a token copy of Goblin Sharpshooter with haste.
Activate the nontoken Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
Activate the token Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to the Elemental token.
The Elemental dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Both Goblin Sharpshooters trigger, untapping themselves.
Repeat from step 2.

914-1799-2048-4050.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1799-2048-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {1}.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard on the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Dockside Extortionist from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then onto the battlefield.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jill, Shiva's Dominant // Shiva, Warden of Ice
